name: Prison
overview: Scripture presents prison as a place of confinement where God's providence and justice are revealed, as seen in Joseph's experience when he was bound and kept in the king's prison (Genesis 39:20). The narratives in Genesis 42 highlight the use of prison as a means to test truth and integrity, with prisoners held in wards and subjected to trials that reveal their character (Genesis 42:16-19). Additionally, Leviticus 24:12 shows that imprisonment can serve a divine purpose, allowing God's mind to be made known through the circumstances of confinement.
